task_title: Tooling — cmd/fetch-history CLI for bulk intraday historical data

priya_plan.plan_summary: Build cmd/fetch-history CLI that reads a universe YAML, iterates instruments x timeframes, and calls FetchCandles for [--from, today) via CachedProvider. Implements dry-run flag, partial-failure progress manifest (cmd-layer concern, distinct from TASK-0080 CachedProvider manifest), and progress logging. Does not use cmdutil.BuildProvider — constructs zerodha.Provider directly with --api-key/--access-token flags (env-var fallback). Follows run() extraction convention for testability. TDD order: tests written first covering dry-run, partial-failure manifest, resume-from-manifest, and flag validation.
priya_plan.approach: main() is a one-liner delegating to run(args, stdout, stderr, providerFactory). run() uses flag.NewFlagSet with ContinueOnError; flags are --universe, --timeframe (repeatable), --from, --cache-dir, --api-key (env: KITE_API_KEY), --access-token (env: KITE_ACCESS_TOKEN), --dry-run. The providerFactory is a func() (provider.DataProvider, error) injected by main() for real runs and by tests for mock runs; it is called lazily inside run() only on non-dry-run paths. The inner loop iterates instruments x timeframes, reads a local fetch-progress.json progress manifest (cmd-layer partial-failure tracker, not the TASK-0080 CachedProvider manifest) to skip already-completed pairs, calls FetchCandles (CachedProvider write happens automatically on cache miss), updates the manifest atomically on success, and logs progress per pair. Dry-run prints what would be fetched without calling the provider. Tests cover: dry-run output correctness, partial-failure manifest write after second-instrument error, resume skipping completed manifest entries, missing required flags, and env-var fallback for api-key.

build.build_summary: Built cmd/fetch-history CLI with run() extraction pattern, repeatable --timeframe flag, partial-failure progress manifest (atomic write/rename), dry-run mode, and providerFactory injection for test isolation. TDD order honored: main_test.go written first, compilation failed, then main.go written to make tests pass. Lint required two iteration rounds: cyclomatic complexity in run() fixed by extracting parseFlags, printDryRunPlan, resolveProvider, fetchAll, buildCompletedSet, fetchOne helpers; errcheck and gofumpt fixes in test file plus removal of unused sentinel var.
